open.statement: The cure stress in the buckling denominator is absent from CR-1457, DOI 10.2514/3.5568 and DOI 10.2514/3.1932. DELTA-D factor without it is 1.769.
The gradient and bending stresses at 11.3e-6 are absent from those three sources. DELTA-D factor without them is 1.809.
The pressure adder is absent from those three sources. DELTA-D factor without it is 1.740.
The thermal interface margin 1.071 cannot be checked. kb and the cure-temperature increment are not a computable law in the admitted record.
Scarf, splice, mooring and weather headroom were not re-derived. Their mass exceeds the +5.031 kg residual, so the physical float is not independently closed.
